blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en: Asked what to study, which career to pursue, or what product to build, large language models (LLMs) often recommend AI-related options. We ask where this tendency comes from by comparing models before and after fine-tuning and by varying how questions are asked. First, pretrained models already include explicit AI/ML terms in the recommendations of 27% of their responses, and their released instruction-tuned versions do so in 59%. Second, fine-tuning models ourselves shows that this rise is not inevitable: general instruction tuning leaves the rate unchanged, but removing the 7% of instruction examples that concern AI cuts it by 14 percentage points, below the level of the pretrained models it starts from. Data rewarding helpfulness raise it by 9 points, while data ranked by the preferences of diverse simulated users lower it by 9. Finally, with models held fixed, asking for the "best" option or for what to do "right now" raises the rate by 8 and 18 points, whereas telling the model it is an AI advisor adds 4. Overall, the tendency starts in pretraining, and what models learn afterward, together with how a question is phrased, decides how strongly it appears.
blocks.zh: 被问到要学习什么,要追求什么职业,或者要构建什么产品,大型语言模型(LLM)经常推荐AI相关的选项. 我们通过在微调前后比较模型和通过提出不同问题的方式,询问这种趋势从何而来。 首先,经过预先培训的模型已经在27%的答复的建议中包括了明确的AI/ML术语,其发布的指令调整版本则以59%的方式这样做。 第二,微调模型本身表明这种上升并非不可避免的:一般的指令调取率不变,但删除了7%的涉及AI的指令示例将其削减了14个百分点,低于它从预训模型开始的水平. 奖励帮助性的数据将它提升了9分,而数据则根据不同模拟用户的偏好排名将它降低9分. 最后,模型被固定,要求“最佳”选项或“现在”做什么,将费率提高了8分和18分,而模型告诉模型是AI顾问补充说: 4. 总体而言,趋势始于预训,之后哪些模式学习,以及一个问题如何表述,决定了它的出现程度。

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: When users seek open-ended advice from large language models (LLMs), the recommendations can shape which options they consider and, ultimately, their decisions. This makes systematic tendencies in these recommendations important to understand, even when individual suggestions appear reasonable.
blocks.zh: 当用户从大型语言模型(LLM)寻求开放式建议时,建议可以决定他们考虑的选项,并最终决定。 这使得这些建议中的系统趋势十分重要,即使个别建议看来是合理的。

blocks.en: One such tendency is pro-AI prominence: the frequent inclusion of AI-related content in open-ended recommendations. Prior work documented such prominence in open-ended advice, and more favorable estimates for AI cases in matched prediction tasks ( Trabelsi et al., 2026 ) , while other studies report self-preference in LLM evaluations, preferences for AI-generated content, and provider bias in code generation ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Laurito et al., 2025 ; Zhang et al., 2025 ) . This prominence is not necessarily unjustified, but its origins remain unclear: when an instruction-tuned model recommends AI, the recommendation alone does not reveal whether this tendency reflects pretrained behavior, subsequent training, the system context, or the wording of the request itself.
blocks.zh: 支持大赦国际的倾向之一是,经常将与大赦国际有关的内容列入不限成员名额的建议。 先前的工作记录了在开放式咨询意见中的这种突出性,以及在相应的预测任务中对AI案例的更有利的估计(Trabelsi等人,2026年),而其他研究则报告在LLM评价中的自我偏好、对AI生成内容的偏好以及提供商在代码生成中的偏差(Paniksery等人,2024年;Laurito等人,2025年;Zhang等人,2025年)。 这种突出并不一定是没有道理的,但其起源仍然不清楚:当一个经过指导调整的模型推荐AI时,仅此一项建议并不能表明这一趋势是否反映了事先训练过的行为,随后的培训,系统背景,或者请求本身的措辞.

blocks.en: We examine four explanations, which are not mutually exclusive (Figure 1 ). H1 (pretraining prior): pretrained models may already associate AI with innovation, growth, or future value. H2 (post-training): post-training may strengthen or weaken pro-AI prominence, depending on the training data, method and objectives. H3 (AI identity/context): mentioning AI in the system context, particularly by identifying the assistant itself as AI, may change what it recommends. H4 (prompt wording): temporal and superlative wording, such as “right now” and “best”, may shift recommendations toward AI-related content.
blocks.zh: 我们审查了四种并非相互排斥的解释(图1)。 H1(预先培训):预先培训的模型可能已经将AI与创新、增长或未来价值联系起来。 H2(培训后):根据培训数据、方法和目标,培训后可能加强或削弱亲大赦国际的突出地位。 H3(AI身份/背景):在系统背景中提及AI,特别是将助手本身确定为AI,可能会改变它的建议. H4(即时措辞):时间和超时措辞,如“现在”和“最佳”等,可以将建议转向AI相关内容。

blocks.en: Figure 1: Study design. Top: the four possible sources of pro-AI recommendation prominence and the comparison that tests each; controlled branches are compared with their immediate parent. Bottom: the outcome shared by all comparisons.
blocks.zh: 图1:研究设计。 顶部:支持AI推荐突出的四个可能来源,以及每个测试的比较;受控分支与其直系子相比. 底部:所有比较共享的结果.

blocks.en: We pose 20 open-ended advice questions from four domains, each in ten paraphrases, and measure how often a model’s recommendation includes explicit AI/ML terms. To test H1 and H2, we compare ten released Base–Instruct pairs and train eleven pretrained models with six post-training recipes, comparing each recipe with its parent checkpoint. To test H3 and H4, we vary the system message and the wording of the question for ten instruction-tuned models.
blocks.zh: 我们提出了来自四个领域的20个不限名额的咨询问题,每个问题都用10个句子,并衡量一个模型的建议在多大程度上包括明确的AI/ML术语。 为了测试H1和H2,我们用6种训练后食谱来比较10种发布的Base-Instruct 配对和11种训练前训练的型号,将每种食谱与母检点进行比较. 为了测试H3和H4,我们为十个指令调制模型修改了系统消息和问题的措辞.

blocks.en: Pro-AI prominence is already substantial in pretrained models, consistent with H1, and far higher in their released instruction-tuned counterparts. Controlled post-training shows that this shift is not a generic effect of instruction tuning (H2): general supervised fine-tuning (SFT) leaves pro-AI prominence almost unchanged, whereas other training recipes raise or lower it depending on their data. At inference time, temporal and superlative wording (H4) raise pro-AI prominence far more than AI cues in the system context (H3), and identifying the assistant itself as AI adds no significant further increase.
blocks.zh: 与H1一致的预训模式中,支持AI的突出程度已经相当高,在发布的指令调整模式中则要高得多。 受控制的后培训表明,这种转变不是指导调制(H2)的通用效果:一般的受监督的微调(SFT)使得亲AI的显著性几乎保持不变,而其他培训配方则根据数据提高或降低. 在推论中,时间和超时间措辞(H4)在系统背景(H3)中比AI提示更加突出,并且将助手本身确定为AI没有进一步增加。

blocks.en: 2 Related Work
blocks.zh: 2 相关工作

blocks.en: LLM recommendations often reflect factors beyond the substance of a request. Name cues affect employment and salary recommendations ( Nghiem et al., 2024 ) , while demographic and small linguistic cues affect educational recommendations ( Shailya et al., 2025 ; Benedetto et al., 2026 ) . Research has also examined popularity bias in LLM recommenders and changes in product recommendations under different framing ( Lichtenberg et al., 2024 ; Filandrianos et al., 2025 ) .
blocks.zh: 长期管理建议常常反映请求实质内容以外的因素。 名称提示影响就业和工资建议(Nghiem等人,2024年),人口和小语言提示影响教育建议(Shailya等人,2025年;Benedetto等人,2026年)。 研究还审查了不同框架下LLM推荐人中的受欢迎偏差和产品建议的变化(Lichtenberg等人,2024年;Filandrianos等人,2025年)。

blocks.en: 2.1 Bias across training stages
blocks.zh: 2.1 国家 跨培训阶段的偏见

blocks.en: Bias in LLM behavior reflects both pretraining and later training. Instruction-tuned models were shown to exhibit stronger decision biases than Base or less tuned models, yet experiments that vary instruction datasets suggest that several biases follow the pretrained model more closely than the later training data ( Itzhak et al., 2024 ; Itzhak et al., 2025 ) . These studies compare released models or exchange whole instruction datasets; we instead remove one content category from otherwise identical instruction data and compare preference-optimization recipes applied to the same checkpoint. Controlled studies also show that changes to AI-related text during pretraining affect later alignment behavior, even after SFT and Direct Preference Optimization (DPO), and that small differences near the end of pretraining change responses to the same subsequent preference training ( Tice et al., 2026 ; Lu et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: LLM行为中的偏见既反映了预训,也反映了后期训练. 显示经指导调整的模型显示出比Base或较少调整的模型更大的决策偏差,但改变指导数据集的实验表明,一些偏差比后来的培训数据更接近于预先训练过的模型(Itzhak等人,2024年;Itzhak等人,2025年)。 这些研究比较了发布的模型或交换整个指令数据集;我们取而代之的是,从原本相同的指令数据中删除一个内容类别,并比较适用于同一检查站的偏好-优化方法。 受控研究还显示,在预训期间对AI相关文本的修改会影响后来的对齐行为,甚至在SFT和直接偏好优化(DPO)之后,在前期培训的变更回应接近尾声时,对同一后续偏好培训的小差异(Tice等人,2026年;Lu等人,2026年).

blocks.en: Preference optimization was shown to reinforce biases in training feedback, including through methods such as DPO ( Rafailov et al., 2023 ) : biased preference rewards increase models’ tendency to agree with users, while preference models favor simple features such as length, technical language, and agreement ( Shapira et al., 2026 ; Bharadwaj et al., 2026 ) . Together, these findings suggest that both training history and post-training choices matter; we test their effects on pro-AI recommendations.
blocks.zh: 优待优化显示在培训反馈中强化了偏见,包括通过DPO(Rafailov等人,2023年)等方法:偏好奖励会增加模式与用户一致的倾向,而偏好模式则倾向于长度、技术语言和协议等简单特征(Shapira等人,2026年;Bharadwaj等人,2026年)。 这些调查结果合在一起表明,培训历史和培训后的选择都很重要;我们检验它们对支持大赦国际的建议的影响。

blocks.en: 2.2 Prompt and system-context effects
blocks.zh: 2.2 即时和系统文本效应

blocks.en: Model behavior also varies with prompt wording. Evaluation results based on a single instruction template differ from averages across paraphrases, and even meaning-preserving edits substantially change outcomes ( Mizrahi et al., 2024 ; Sclar et al., 2024 ) . Specific effects include apparent publication dates favoring newer passages during reranking and context cues changing how models respond to assumptions in user requests ( Fang et al., 2025 ; Cheng et al., 2026 ) . Targeted prompt changes are also often difficult to distinguish from ordinary sensitivity to wording ( Yang et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 模型行为也随即措辞而变化. 基于单一指令模板的评价结果不同于各句句的平均值,即使保留意义也编辑了实质性改变结果(Mizrahi等人,2024年;Sclar等人,2024年)。 具体效果包括:在重新排位时明显公布日期有利于较新的段落,以及上下文提示改变模型如何响应用户要求中的假设(Fang等人,2025年;Cheng等人,2026年)。 有针对性的即时修改也往往难以区别于对措辞的普通敏感性(杨等人,2026年).

blocks.en: System prompts provide another source of variation. Assigning roles to an assistant was shown to affect its answers without consistently improving task accuracy ( Zheng et al., 2024 ) . We therefore distinguish changes caused by wording and surrounding context from those caused by identifying the assistant as AI.
blocks.zh: 系统提示提供了另一种变异源. 向助理分配角色被证明影响其答案,而没有始终如一地提高任务准确性(郑等人,2024年)。 因此,我们将措辞和周围环境引起的变化与将助理确定为大赦国际所引起的变化加以区分。

blocks.en: 2.3 AI as a subject of preference
blocks.zh: 2.3 大赦国际作为首选对象

blocks.en: AI is itself a subject of model preferences. LLM evaluators were shown to favor their own generations, while preferences for LLM-generated communication and for evaluators’ own model-generated résumés have been observed in other decisions ( Panickssery et al., 2024 ; Laurito et al., 2025 ; Xu et al., 2025 ) . Provider preferences also appear in code generation and recommendations among competing AI models ( Zhang et al., 2025 ; Dubash and Friedler, 2026 ) . These effects concern who produced the content or which provider is favored, rather than whether AI or ML appears within the recommendation itself. Closest to our study, prior work documented AI prominence in open-ended recommendations and more favorable estimates for matched AI cases in salary and program-completion tasks ( Trabelsi et al., 2026 ) . Whereas that work documents the phenomenon, we study where it comes from, across pretraining, controlled post-training, and inference-time prompts.
blocks.zh: AI本身就是一个模式偏好的主题. LLM评价员被证明有利于他们自己的世代,而其他决定(Panickssery等人,2024年;Laurito等人,2025年;Xu等人,2025年)则倾向于LLM生成的通信和评价员自己模型生成的简历。 提供商的偏好也出现在相互竞争的AI模型中的代码生成和建议中(Zhang等人,2025年;Dubash和Friedler,2026年)。 这些影响涉及由谁制作内容或哪些提供者受到青睐,而不是建议本身中是否出现AI或ML。 与我们的研究最接近的是,先前的工作记录了大赦国际在开放式建议中的突出地位,以及比较有利的工资和方案完成任务方面对应的大赦国际案例估计数(Trabelsi等人,2026年)。 虽然这项工作记录了这种现象,但我们研究了它从何而来,跨越培训前、控制后培训和推断时间。

blocks.en: 3 Experimental Design
blocks.zh: 3 实验设计

blocks.en: 3.1 Recommendation task
blocks.zh: 3.1 建议的任务

blocks.en: We study open-ended advice questions with many plausible answers. The four domains are Study , Career , Startup , and Scientific Research . Study, Career, and Startup follow Trabelsi et al. (2026) , who chose domains covering consequential choices for which users commonly seek LLM advice. We add Scientific Research because researchers widely use LLMs in their work ( Liao et al., 2025 ) , and LLMs are increasingly studied as sources of research ideas ( Si et al., 2025 ) . Each domain contains five conceptual questions, each asked in ten fixed paraphrases. The questions are in English and contain no information about the person asking. All comparisons except the wording test ask every question with both a superlative and a temporal cue (e.g., “What is the best {concept} right now?”); the wording test varies these cues. All responses are generated with temperature 0, top-p 1, a 512-token output limit, and seed 12345, with thinking disabled for Qwen models.
blocks.zh: 我们研究不限成员名额的咨询问题,并提出许多可信的答案。 四个领域是研究、职业、启动和科学研究。 研究、职业和启动跟踪Trabelsi等人(2026年),他们选择了涵盖用户通常寻求LLM建议的相应选择的领域。 我们加入了科学研究,因为研究人员在工作中广泛使用LLMs(廖等人,2025年),LLMs作为研究思想的来源越来越多地被研究(Si等人,2025年). 每个域包含五个概念性问题,每个问题都用十个固定的句法来问. 问题用英文提出,没有关于提问者的信息。 除了措辞测试之外,所有比较都用超时提示和时间提示(例如,“什么是最好的{概念}现在? ” )来提出每个问题;措辞测试则不同。 所有响应都是用温度0,顶端-p 1,一个512个托肯输出极限,以及种子12345生成的,思绪为Quen模型所禁用.

blocks.en: 3.2 Primary outcome
blocks.zh: 3.2 主要结果

blocks.en: We first detect explicit AI/ML terms (e.g., artificial intelligence, machine learning, deep learning, LLMs and generative AI; full list in Appendix A.5 ) using fixed lexical patterns, then use two LLM filters to exclude mentions outside the recommendation itself. Responses without such terms are counted as negative. Each filter must answer with a single yes/no label; any other output (0.1% of DeepSeek and under 0.01% of Qwen judgments) is invalid and treated as missing rather than negative.
blocks.zh: 我们首先用固定的词典模式检测明确的AI/ML术语(如人工智能,机器学习,深层学习,LLMs和基因AI;附录A.5中的完整列表),然后使用两个LLM过滤器来排除建议本身以外的提及. 没有这些术语的答复被算作是否定的。 每个过滤器必须使用单一的是/否标签回答;任何其他输出(0.1%的DeepSeek和0.01%的Quen判断以下)都是无效的,被视为缺失而非负的.

blocks.en: We use Qwen3.6-27B and DeepSeek-V4-Flash as the two filters. Each filter’s rate is computed over the responses it classified validly, and the two rates are averaged with equal weight for each model, condition, and question.
blocks.zh: 我们使用Quen3.6-27B和DeepSeek-V4-Flash作为两个过滤器. 每个过滤器的速率是在其有效分类的答复中计算出来的,而这两个速率的平均值是每个模型、条件和问题同等的权重。

blocks.en: Our measure of pro-AI prominence is the share of responses with explicit AI/ML terms within their recommendations, averaged over the two filters. Responses without a recommendation count as zero, so the measure reflects how often a user who asks the question receives an AI recommendation. Empty responses are excluded rather than counted as zero (Appendix A.5 ).
blocks.zh: 我们衡量支持大赦国际的突出程度,是在其建议中包含明确AI/ML术语的答复比例,平均是两个过滤器。 没有建议的答复计为零,因此该措施反映了提问的用户收到AI建议的次数. 空回复被排除在外,而不是算为零(附录A.5 )。

blocks.en:
Because LLM-based judgments can depend on the evaluator,
we also examine the two filters separately ( Verga et al., 2024 ; Thakur et al., 2025 ) .
The two filters give nearly identical effect estimates ( r = 0.990 r=0.990 ) and agree on which effects are significant, except for one small effect in the AI-context test (Appendix Table 15 ). On 200 detector-positive responses labeled by a human expert, the measure agrees with the expert on 85.2% (95% CI [81.0, 89.5]), with 96.9% precision and 86.6% recall (Appendix A.12 ).
blocks.zh:
由于基于LLM的判断可以依赖于评价者,
我们还分别检查这两个过滤器(Verga等人,2024年;Thakur等人,2025年)。
两个滤波器给出了几乎完全相同的效果估计(r = 0.990 r = 0.990),并商定哪些效果是显著的,除了AI-context测试中的一个小效果(附录表15). 关于一位人类专家标注的200项检测器阳性反应,该措施与专家一致,为85.2%(95%CI [81.0,89.5),精确度为96.9%,召回率为86.6%(附录A.12)。

blocks.en: 3.3 Statistical analysis
blocks.zh: 3.3 统计分析

blocks.en: Effects are calculated from matched experimental conditions, averaging equally across the evaluated models and the 20 questions (five per domain). The 20 questions are our statistical units; the ten paraphrases of a question are treated as repeated wordings of it, not as separate observations.
blocks.zh: 影响根据相应的实验条件计算,在所评价的模型和20个问题(每个领域5个)中平均相同。 这20个问题是我们的统计单位;一个问题的10个释义被作为它的重复措辞,而不是作为单独的观察.

blocks.en: We compute 95% confidence intervals by resampling questions within each domain (20,000 bootstrap samples).
blocks.zh: 我们计算95%的置信间隔,方法是在每个域重新取样问题(20 000个靴子样本)。

blocks.en: Significance is tested by flipping the signs of the 20 question-level effects in all 2 20 2^{20} possible ways (two-sided exact test of the null hypothesis that each question’s effect is equally likely to be positive or negative). We apply Holm correction separately within the four prespecified hypothesis families (H1: one test; H2: six; H3: three; H4: three), using α = 0.05 \alpha=0.05 .
blocks.zh: 通过将20个问题层面效应的征兆翻转到所有2 20 个 2 + 20 个可能方式(对每个问题的效果同样可能是正或负的无效假设的双面精确测试)来测试意义. 我们在四个预先指定的假说家族中分别应用Holm校正(H1:一个测试;H2:6;H3:3;H4:3),使用α=0.05\α=0.05.

blocks.en: 4 How Post-Training Changes Pro-AI Prominence
blocks.zh: 4 培训后的变化 突出

blocks.en:
We first ask whether pro-AI prominence is already present
before instruction tuning, and whether subsequent training consistently amplifies it. We address these questions through released Base–Instruct comparisons and controlled experiments with specific post-training recipes.
blocks.zh:
我们先问一下,支持大赦国际的影响力是否已经存在?
在教学之前,以及随后的培训是否不断扩大。 我们通过发行的Base - 指示比较和有控制的实验与具体的训练后食谱来解决这些问题.

blocks.en: Figure 2: Released Base–Instruct contrast (top) and six controlled post-training comparisons. Markers show effects with 95% confidence intervals. Each controlled branch is compared with its immediate parent, as identified by the row labels.
blocks.zh: 图2:发布基地-指示对比(上)和6个受控培训后比较. 标记以95%的置信间隔显示效果. 每个受控分支都与其直系母体进行比较,由行标签确定.

blocks.en: 4.1 Released Instruct models show a large shift
blocks.zh: 4.1 发布指示模型显示大转变

blocks.en: Released Instruct checkpoints include explicit AI/ML terms within recommendations substantially more often than their pretrained Base counterparts. Across ten matched Base–Instruct model lines from five open-weight model families, pro-AI prominence increases by an average of 32.48 percentage points (95% CI [29.46, 35.39]; Holm-adjusted p < .001 p<.001 ). On average, 26.80% of responses from released Base checkpoints and 59.28% from released Instruct checkpoints recommend an option with explicit AI/ML terms.

blocks.en: 4.2 Controlled post-training reveals different effects

Each procedure is compared with its immediate parent under the same fixed input formats. The two SFT branches compare ordinary instruction tuning with tuning on the same data minus its AI-related examples; the four branches built on General SFT add common later stages: helpfulness, safety, or persona/value-oriented preference optimization, or role-conditioned instruction tuning.

blocks.en: 6 Discussion
blocks.zh: 讨论

blocks.en: Recent work found that models often recommend AI, but did not call this recommendation pattern bias, because no reference says how often AI should be recommended ( Trabelsi et al., 2026 ) . Our comparisons do not need such a reference: each holds the advice question fixed, yet pretrained and instruction-tuned versions, models trained on different data, and models given different system messages recommend AI at very different rates, from 11% after Clean no-AI SFT to 73% when the question asks for the best option right now. Whatever the appropriate rate is, they cannot all be right. We therefore call a shift toward AI-related options in what models recommend, relative to the same question under another condition, pro-AI bias .
blocks.zh: 最近的工作发现模型经常推荐AI,但并未称此建议模式偏差,因为没有参考文献说AI应该推荐多少次(Trabelsi等人,2026年). 我们的比较不需要这样的参考:每个都把咨询问题固定下来,但经过预先培训和调整的版本、接受不同数据培训的模型以及给予不同系统消息的模型都以非常不同的速度推荐AI,从Clean no-AI SFT之后的11%到现在问到最佳选择的73%。 无论适当的费率是多少,它们不可能都是对的。 因此,我们呼吁在模型建议中,相对于同一问题,在另一个条件下,转向与AI有关的选择,即支持AI。

blocks.en: The largest shifts come from factors that add little information about the user’s needs. A user asking for advice already wants the best option for their current situation, yet saying “best” or “right now” pushes models strongly toward AI. Released Instruct checkpoints recommend AI-related options far more often than their Base counterparts; Base models are not explicitly trained to answer questions, but both versions receive identical prompts, designed so that either answers them. Telling the model that it is an AI advisor, or that the conversation will reach an AI grammar checker, also increases AI-related recommendations, although neither changes what would serve the user.
blocks.zh: 最大的变化来自有关用户需求的信息很少的因素。 一个寻求咨询意见的用户已经想得到他们目前状况的最佳选择,然而说“最佳”或“现在”则将模型大力推向AI。 发布指令的检查站推荐AI相关选项的频率远比Base对应的要高; Base模型没有被明确训练回答问题,但两个版本都得到相同的提示,设计时要么给出答案. 告诉模型是AI顾问,或者对话会到达AI语法检查器,也增加了AI相关的建议,尽管两者都不改变为用户服务的内容.

blocks.en: Removing only the 7.2% of instruction examples that concern AI does not merely prevent an increase: it lowers pro-AI prominence below its pretrained baseline, whereas General SFT on the full data leaves it nearly unchanged. One explanation is that ordinary instruction data pull in two directions: most examples encourage a broad range of answers, whereas the AI-related examples reinforce AI as a ready answer, and in General SFT the two roughly cancel. Previous work shows that instruction data selection substantially affects the balance of learned capabilities ( Dai et al., 2025 ) , and that AI-related discourse during pretraining influences later model behavior ( Tice et al., 2026 ) .
blocks.zh: 仅删除涉及AI的7.2%的指令示例并不仅仅防止增加:它将亲AI的突出度降低到其预先训练的基线之下,而全数据上的通用SFT则几乎保持不变。 一个解释是,普通指令数据有两个方向:大多数实例鼓励广泛的答案,而AI相关实例则强化AI作为现成的答案,在一般的SFT中,两者大致取消. 以前的工作显示,教学数据选择对学习能力的平衡有重大影响(Dai等人,2025年),在培训前的AI相关论述影响后来的模型行为(Tice等人,2026年)。

blocks.en: Preference models are known to reward specific features of a response, such as length or technical language, and not only its quality ( Bharadwaj et al., 2026 ) , so DPO could favor answers that sound impressive, such as recommending AI. Yet Helpfulness DPO and Persona DPO apply the same method to the same checkpoint and move pro-AI prominence in opposite directions: the preference data, not the method, determine the direction. Helpfulness-oriented feedback may favor solutions perceived as broadly capable, making AI an attractive answer to underspecified requests. Persona DPO instead uses feedback drawn from heterogeneous synthetic personas and opinion-dividing questions ( Castricato et al., 2025 ) ; learning that the best answer depends on who is asking may make models less inclined to push a single default answer, such as AI.
blocks.zh: 优待模式已知可以奖励一个响应的具体特征,如长度或技术语言,而不只是其质量(Bharadwaj等人,2026年),因此DPO可以倾向于听起来令人印象深刻的答案,例如推荐AI. 然而,Helpfinity DPO和Persona DPO对同一个检查站采用同样的方法,并将亲AI的突出位置移到相反的方向:偏好数据而不是方法决定方向. 面向帮助的反馈可能有利于被认为具有广泛能力的解决方案,从而使AI成为对未明确要求的有吸引力的答案. 相反,Persona DPO使用从不同的合成人和意见分歧问题(Castricato等人,2025年)中得出的反馈;了解到最佳答案取决于谁在要求,可能使模型不太倾向于推动单一的默认答案,例如AI.

blocks.en: Directional tendencies matter in open-ended advice, where recommending one plausible option directs attention away from others; this connects our findings to the broader study of biases in recommendation selection ( Klimashevskaia et al., 2024 ) . AI-related instruction data, helpfulness preferences, and prompt framing may each make AI more accessible as a broadly desirable answer, especially when a request emphasizes performance or current relevance. Whether models favor AI beyond what the suitability of the alternatives warrants remains open; answering it requires comparing AI and non-AI recommendations under matched user needs and known differences in suitability. Because model evaluation is sensitive to prompt formulation ( Mizrahi et al., 2024 ) , such comparisons should span multiple plausible requests.
blocks.zh: 指导性倾向在不限名额的建议中很重要,其中建议一种可行的选择会引开对他人的注意;这使我们的调查结果与对建议选择中的偏差的更广泛研究联系起来(Klimashevskaia等人,2024年)。 与AI有关的指令数据、帮助性偏好和迅速设定,都可能使AI更容易作为广泛需要的答案而获得,特别是当请求强调性能或当前的相关性时。 模型是否在替代方法的合适性之外偏好AI,尚没有定论;在回答这个问题时,需要根据匹配的用户需求和已知的适合性差异对AI和非AI建议进行比较。 由于模型评价对即时制剂很敏感(Mizrahi等人,2024年),因此,这种比较应涵盖多个可能的请求。

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: Pretrained models already recommend AI often, and their released instruction-tuned versions do so far more. Yet this rise is not inevitable: the data a model is trained on can raise or lower the tendency, and ordinary words such as “best” and “right now” push models toward AI more than telling them that they are AI. Because the same question receives such different answers depending on training and wording, these shifts reflect the models rather than the needs of the user asking. Developers can therefore shape pro-AI prominence through their choice of training data and preference objectives, and evaluations of LLM advice should test several phrasings of the same request.
blocks.zh: 预先训练过的模型已经经常推荐AI,而其发布的指令调制版本到目前为止做得更多. 但这种上升并非不可避免的:一个模型所训练的数据可以提高或降低这种倾向,普通的词语如“最佳”和“现在”将模型推向AI,而不是告诉他们它们是AI。 由于同一问题因培训和措辞的不同而得到如此不同的答案,这些变化反映的是模式而不是用户询问的需求. 因此,开发者可以通过选择培训数据和偏好目标来塑造亲AI的突出地位,对LLM建议的评价应测试同一请求的几种措辞.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: We measure explicit AI/ML terminology within recommendations, not their quality or whether AI-related advice is justified. This measure can miss implicit AI recommendations, and compared with a human expert it misses some explicit ones (86.6% recall), so its absolute rates are conservative.
blocks.zh: 我们衡量的是建议中明确的AI/ML术语,而不是其质量或与AI有关的咨询意见是否合理。 这项措施可能忽略了AI的隐含建议,而与一位人类专家相比,它忽略了一些明确的建议(86.6%),因此其绝对比率是保守的。

blocks.en: Base checkpoints establish that the tendency is already present, but not its origin within pretraining. Recent enthusiasm for AI may contribute to this tendency, but further research is needed to determine its influence. Controlled comparisons evaluate complete training recipes rather than isolating individual mechanisms, and each branch has only one training run per model. Statistical inference treats the evaluated models as fixed and resamples questions; the findings may differ across other models, languages, domains, and settings.
blocks.zh: 基地检查站证实,这一趋势已经存在,但并非其起源于预先训练。 最近对大赦国际的热情可能助长这一趋势,但需要进一步研究以确定其影响。 控制下的比较评价了完整的培训方法,而不是孤立个别机制,每个处只有每个模式的一次培训。 统计推论将评价的模型视为固定问题和再现问题;其他模型、语言、域和设置的结论可能有所不同。

blocks.en: A paid expert who was not involved in the study labeled 200 detector-positive responses, 50 from each experiment and 50 from each domain, sampled with a fixed seed without reading either filter’s labels. The expert received the filters’ instructions verbatim and the same fields as the filters (domain, concept, question, and response), and answered Y or N with the filters’ meaning. Table 16 compares each filter and the two-filter measure with the expert; where the two filters disagree, the measure scores 0.5. Intervals are 95% bootstrap intervals that resample responses within each experiment (10,000 draws). Because the sample is balanced rather than random, these figures describe this sample, not the full corpus. Most disagreements are responses that the expert counted as AI recommendations and the filters did not. Agreement is lower for pretrained than for post-trained responses (71.2% vs. 88.0%), but not because of a larger undercount: the measure’s rate is about 10 points below the expert’s for both (74.2% vs. 84.8% and 83.2% vs. 92.8%).
